

Pásame esa salida.


Con ella te daré el reemplazo exacto del bloque `add_custom_command()`. Mantendremos intacto todo lo demás y luego reconstruiremos únicamente:


```
mouse
```


No vamos todavía con `system`, `timer`, `mmsystem`, etc. Primero hacemos que **MOUSE** quede limpio y verificamos:


```
ERRORES: 0
Built target mouse
mouse.drv16
PE32 executable for MS Windows 6.00 (DLL), Intel i386
```


y solo entonces avanzamos al siguiente módulo.

file(GLOB SOURCE *.c *.cpp)

set(MOUSE_RC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mouse.rc")
set(MOUSE_RC_OBJ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mouse.rc.obj")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${MOUSE_RC_OBJ}"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/commdlg/llvm-windres-wrapper.sh
        --target=i686-w64-mingw32
        --input-format=rc
        --output-format=coff
        --output=${MOUSE_RC_OBJ}
        --preprocessor=clang
        --preprocessor-arg=--target=i686-w64-mingw32
        --preprocessor-arg=--sysroot=$ENV{PREFIX}/opt/llvm-mingw-w64/i686-w64-mingw32
        --preprocessor-arg=-I$ENV{PREFIX}/opt/llvm-mingw-w64/generic-w64-mingw32/include
        --preprocessor-arg=-I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wininclude
        --preprocessor-arg=-I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wine
        --preprocessor-arg=-I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wow32
        --preprocessor-arg=-x
        --preprocessor-arg=c
        --preprocessor-arg=-E
        --define=DECLSPEC_HIDDEN=
        --define=HAVE_STRNCASECMP
        --define=HAVE__STRNICMP
        --define=NtCurrentTeb=NtCurrentTeb__
        --define=_WINTERNL_
        --define=_X86_
        --define=__WINESRC__
        --define=__i386__
        --define=strncasecmp=_strnicmp
        --define=WINAPI_PARTITION_DESKTOP=1
        --define=WINAPI_PARTITION_APP=2
        "--define=WINAPI_FAMILY_PARTITION(x)=1"
        --include-dir=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wow32
        --include-dir=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wine
        --include-dir=$ENV{PREFIX}/opt/llvm-mingw-w64/generic-w64-mingw32/include
        "${MOUSE_RC}"
    DEPENDS "${MOUSE_RC}"
    VERBATIM
)

add_library(mouse SHARED
    ${SOURCE}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mouse.def
    mouse.drv16.obj
    "${MOUSE_RC_OBJ}"
)

include_directories(../wine)

add_definitions(
    -D_X86_
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__i386__
    -DHAVE_STRNCASECMP
    -DHAVE__STRNICMP
    -D_WINTERNL_
    -DNtCurrentTeb=NtCurrentTeb__
    -DDECLSPEC_HIDDEN=
    -Dstrncasecmp=_strnicmp
)

spec_build(mouse.drv16 mouse)

target_link_libraries(mouse libwine winecrt0 krnl386)

set_target_properties(mouse PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".drv16")

## Asistente

Perfecto. El CMake actual está limpio y el backup ya está hecho. Vamos a modificar **solo `mouse/CMakeLists.txt`**.


La solución será generar tres pasos:


1. Clang preprocesa `mouse.rc`.
2. `sed` cambia únicamente:


```
BLOCK "0409" "04E4"
```


por:


```
BLOCK "040904E4"
```
3. `llvm-windres` convierte ese recurso corregido a COFF.


Además fijaremos:


```
WINE_CODEPAGE=04E4
--codepage=1252
```


### 1. Sustituye el CMake completo


Ejecuta:


```
Bashcd ~/winevdm

cat > mouse/CMakeLists.txt <<'EOF'
file(GLOB SOURCE *.c *.cpp)

set(MOUSE_RC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mouse.rc")
set(MOUSE_RC_PP "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mouse.preprocessed.rc")
set(MOUSE_RC_FIXED "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mouse.fixed.rc")
set(MOUSE_RC_OBJ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mouse.rc.obj")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${MOUSE_RC_OBJ}"

    COMMAND /bin/sh -c
        "clang
        --target=i686-w64-mingw32
        --sysroot=$ENV{PREFIX}/opt/llvm-mingw-w64/i686-w64-mingw32
        -I$ENV{PREFIX}/opt/llvm-mingw-w64/generic-w64-mingw32/include
        -I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wininclude
        -I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wine
        -I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wow32
        -D_X86_
        -D__WINESRC__
        -D__i386__
        -D_WINTERNL_
        -DNtCurrentTeb=NtCurrentTeb__
        -DDECLSPEC_HIDDEN=
        -DHAVE_STRNCASECMP
        -DHAVE__STRNICMP
        -Dstrncasecmp=_strnicmp
        -DWINAPI_PARTITION_DESKTOP=1
        -DWINAPI_PARTITION_APP=2
        '-DWINAPI_FAMILY_PARTITION(x)=1'
        -DWINE_CODEPAGE=04E4
        -x c
        -E
        '${MOUSE_RC}'
        > '${MOUSE_RC_PP}'
        &&
        sed 's/BLOCK \"0409\" \"04E4\"/BLOCK \"040904E4\"/'
        '${MOUSE_RC_PP}'
        > '${MOUSE_RC_FIXED}'"

    COMMAND ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/commdlg/llvm-windres-wrapper.sh
        --target=i686-w64-mingw32
        --input-format=rc
        --output-format=coff
        --output=${MOUSE_RC_OBJ}
        --codepage=1252
        "${MOUSE_RC_FIXED}"

    DEPENDS
        "${MOUSE_RC}"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/wine/wine/wine_common_ver.rc"

    VERBATIM
)

add_library(mouse SHARED
    ${SOURCE}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mouse.def
    mouse.drv16.obj
    "${MOUSE_RC_OBJ}"
)

include_directories(../wine)

add_definitions(
    -D_X86_
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__i386__
    -DHAVE_STRNCASECMP
    -DHAVE__STRNICMP
    -D_WINTERNL_
    -DNtCurrentTeb=NtCurrentTeb__
    -DDECLSPEC_HIDDEN=
    -Dstrncasecmp=_strnicmp
)

spec_build(mouse.drv16 mouse)

target_link_libraries(mouse libwine winecrt0 krnl386)

set_target_properties(mouse PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".drv16")
EOF
```


### 2. Verifica el archivo antes de compilar


```
Bashcd ~/winevdm

echo "===== CMAKE MOUSE ====="
sed -n '1,130p' mouse/CMakeLists.txt
```


Si el contenido aparece correctamente, ejecutaremos después:

y **todavía no compilaremos** hasta comprobar que CMake acepta esta nueva regla.
